prompt:
You judge whether one job posting is relevant to a candidate profile.

Candidate profile (fictional):
{
 "target_titles": [
  "supply chain analyst",
  "supply chain strategy",
  "procurement analyst",
  "demand planner",
  "project manager",
  "product manager",
  "operations analyst"
 ],
 "skills": [
  "sql",
  "power bi",
  "sap",
  "mrp",
  "forecasting",
  "inventory",
  "excel",
  "procurement"
 ],
 "locations": [
  "boston",
  "cambridge",
  "somerville",
  "massachusetts"
 ],
 "exclude_keywords": [
  "director",
  "vp",
  "principal",
  "senior manager",
  "10+ years",
  "8+ years",
  "phd required"
 ]
}

Posting:
{
 "posting_id": "8335610",
 "title": "Mechanical Project Manager",
 "location": "Boston, MA"
}

A posting is relevant if it is a supply chain, procurement, planning or ops analyst role, entry to mid level (5 years or less), in Boston or remote.

Reply with JSON only. No prose, no code fences. Exactly these keys:
{"posting_id": "<the posting_id above>", "verdict": "relevant" or "not_relevant", "resume_fields": [names from: target_titles, skills, locations, exclude_keywords], "posting_fields": [names from: title, content, location], "justification": "<one to three sentences naming the specific terms behind the verdict>"}
raw_response: {"posting_id": "8335610", "verdict": "not_relevant", "resume_fields": ["target_titles", "locations"], "posting_fields": ["title", "location"], "justification": "The location 'Boston, MA' matches, and 'project manager' appears in target_titles, but 'Mechanical Project Manager' is an engineering/construction project role, not a supply chain, procurement, planning or ops analyst role. No posting content was provided to show any supply chain duties or the seniority level."}
